properties.description: Mapping Data Flow for MCF Cuentas extraction. Maps DataStage stages: EDWOS_TRANSBK_MCF(CSeqFileStage source, FixedWidth=1) -> Trf_MCF_C(CTransformerStage, splits to Cuentas/Eliminados) -> Trf_MCF_C_Final(CTransformerStage, final filter) -> Trf_MCF_Cuentas(CTransformerStage, business logic + state machine) -> Seq_MCF_C(CSeqFileStage sink) AND -> FL_Cuentas(TeradataConnector FastLoad, MCF_Account_Num_Tmp). Also: Hsh_Bci_Ptc, Hsh_Card_ANum, Hsh_Card_ANum2, Hsh_EIH_Rut lookups, LDM read stage.

sources.name: SourceCuentas
sources.description: IBM MCF Cuentas fixed-width file. Maps to DataStage EDWOS_TRANSBK_MCF CSeqFileStage output Lnk_MCF_Cuentas.

sources.name: LookupBciPtc
sources.description: Teradata LDM lookup (Hsh_Bci_Ptc). Maps Lnk_Bci_Ptc from LDM stage (Context=1, read mode). Lookup on NRUT/account keys.

sources.name: LookupTab
sources.description: Teradata LDM Tab lookup (Hsh_Card_Dic). Maps Lnk_Tab from LDM stage.

sources.name: LookupTab352
sources.description: Teradata LDM Tab352 lookup (variant). Maps Lnk_Tab_352 from LDM stage.

sources.name: LookupEihRut
sources.description: Teradata EIH_Rut lookup (Hsh_EIH_Rut). Maps Lnk_EIH_Rut from LDM stage.

sinks.name: SinkCuentasFinal
sinks.description: Write filtered Cuentas to EDWOS.TRANSBK.MCF.CUENTA.TXT.FINAL. Maps to DataStage Seq_MCF_C (CSeqFileStage input, FileName=#$PathInput#EDWOS.TRANSBK.MCF.CUENTA.TXT.FINAL).

sinks.name: SinkMCFAccountNumTmp
sinks.description: FastLoad MCF_Account_Num_Tmp in $EDW_Wrk. Maps to DataStage FL_Cuentas (TeradataConnector CC_GUI FastLoad WriteMode=0).

sinks.name: SinkNoProcessed
sinks.description: Rejected/unprocessed records. Maps to DataStage Seq_No_Procesados CSeqFileStage.

transformations.name: ParseFixedWidth
transformations.description: CRITICAL: Parse COBOL fixed-width fields from IBM file. DataStage handles this via NativeType=CHARACTER/DISPLAY_NUMERIC and field positions. ADF: Use substring() expressions for each field offset. MANUAL: Implement based on COBOL copybook byte positions.

transformations.name: Trf_MCF_C
transformations.description: Initial Cuentas split transformer. Splits into: Lnk_MCF_C_Final (valid Cuentas) + Lnk_MCF_C_Elim (eliminated records). Maps DataStage CTransformerStage Trf_MCF_C. Key logic: AMC_TIPO_REG1='01' filter, IND/TipoCuenta variable assignments.

transformations.name: StateMachine
transformations.description: AMC_EST_CTA state machine. DataStage Trf_MCF_Cuentas assigns IND, TipoCuenta, Bloqueo1, Bloqueo2, Estado variables based on complex conditional expressions. Maps to ADF DerivedColumn with nested iif() expressions.

transformations.name: LookupBciPtcJoin
transformations.description: Hash lookup on Hsh_Bci_Ptc. Maps DataStage CHashedFileStage lookup. ADF: Lookup transformation on LookupBciPtc source keyed on AMC_NRUT.

transformations.name: DeriveAccountNum
transformations.description: Derive Account_Num field. DataStage: Account_Num = trim(AMC_ACCT). ADF: DerivedColumn trim(toString(AMC_ACCT)).
